note: Every conditional skip in the test suite, declared. Regenerate with `node scripts/check-test-collection.mjs --update`. A skip is visible in the runner's output; a file that never loads is not, and neither is countable across machines unless it is written down here. Measured: 611 tests on a development machine, 606 on a clean clone — 7 reported skipped and 5 that left the total unannounced.

skips.wouldRunIf: The fetch script retrieves the scan; CORPUS §2.7 records why no committable one exists.
